record.original_question: For primes p >= 3, can one prove a finite upper bound for the symbol lengths l_F(p, p^2) and l_F(p^2, p^2)?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.6. Find an upper bound on l_F(p, p^2) and l_F(p^2, p^2) for p >= 3.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $F$ be a field and let $p \ge 3$ be a prime. Assume that $F$ contains a primitive $p^2$-th root of unity. Recall that for positive integers $e$ and $i$ with $e \mid i$, a central simple $F$-algebra is said to have exponent $e$ if its class in the Brauer group $\mathrm{Br}(F)$ has order $e$, and to have index $i$ if its underlying division algebra has degree $i$ over its center. A symbol algebra of degree $n$ over $F$ is a cyclic $F$-algebra of the form
$$ (a, b)_{n, \zeta_n} = F\langle x, y \mid x^n = a,\ y^n = b,\ yx = \zeta_n xy\rangle, \qquad a, b \in F^\times,$$
where $\zeta_n$ is a primitive $n$-th root of unity in $F$. By the Merkurjev–Suslin theorem, every central simple $F$-algebra of exponent dividing $n$ is Brauer-equivalent to a tensor product of finitely many symbol algebras of degree $n$.

Define the symbol length
$$ \ell_F(e, i) \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0} \cup \{\infty\} $$
to be the least integer $\ell$ such that every central simple $F$-algebra of exponent dividing $e$ and index dividing $i$ is Brauer-equivalent to a tensor product of at most $\ell$ symbol algebras of degree $i$ over $F$; set $\ell_F(e, i) = \infty$ if no such finite $\ell$ exists.

Question: Does there exist a finite upper bound, depending only on $p$ (and not on the field $F$), for $\ell_F(p, p^2)$ and for $\ell_F(p^2, p^2)$, valid for every field $F$ of characteristic different from $p$ containing a primitive $p^2$-th root of unity?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature on symbol length in Brauer groups (e.g., works on symbol length over elliptic curves and surveys following the open problem list of Auel–Brussel–Garibaldi–Vishne) continues to treat finite uniform upper bounds for $\ell_F(p, p^2)$ and $\ell_F(p^2, p^2)$ for $p \ge 3$ as open. No source establishing such finite bounds in general was found.

status_evidence.title: Symbol Length in Brauer Groups of Elliptic Curves
status_evidence.snippet: Provides bounds on symbol length in the p-torsion of Brauer groups in restricted settings (CM elliptic curves), indicating general bounds for higher p^k-torsion remain a focus of current research.
status_evidence.claim: Symbol-length bounds for p^k-torsion of the Brauer group are still being investigated, with general uniform bounds not established.

status_evidence.title: Symbol length in the Brauer group of a field
status_evidence.snippet: Survey/research paper discussing what is known and unknown about symbol length, with bounds for exponent-p classes but limited results for higher exponents like p^2.
status_evidence.claim: Finite uniform bounds for $\ell_F(p^2, p^2)$ remain unestablished in general.
